name: @mapctx/sync-engine
description: Sync TASKS.md with GitHub Issues and Projects v2

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/mapctx-cli.js && rm -rf dist/workspace-ui && mkdir -p dist/workspace-ui && cp ../vscode-extension/src/html/workspaceV2.* dist/workspace-ui/
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.dev:status: npm run build && node dist/cli.js status --config mapcs.dev.json
scripts.dev:pull: npm run build && node dist/cli.js pull --dry-run --config mapcs.dev.json
scripts.dev:push: npm run build && node dist/cli.js push --dry-run --config mapcs.dev.json
